questions.q: The aircraft is lying upside down. In Betaflight 2025.12, what is the correct way to enter turtle mode and leave it (the method that works in any version)?
options: ARM, then the turtle switch; exit — turn the turtle switch off at any moment
The turtle switch, then ARM; exit — disarm, turtle off, ARM again
The turtle switch with ARM on; exit — throttle above 20 %
Stick arming with the throttle centered; exit — repeat the arm gesture
questions.explain: tryArm() sends DShot command 21 (reverse) only if the mode is active at the moment of arming. The crashFlipModeActive state (in 4.5 — flipOverAfterCrashActive) is reset on disarm, and the next arm without the mode sends command 20 (normal direction). In 4.5 turning the switch off while armed changes nothing; in 2025.12 turning it off with crashflip_auto_rearm = OFF causes a disarm and the FLIP_SWITCH flag, so a manual disarm and a new arm are needed anyway.

questions.q: A CLI fragment. Why does dynamic idle not work?
questions.fragment:
# get dyn_idle_min_rpm
dyn_idle_min_rpm = 35
# get dshot_bidir
dshot_bidir = OFF
# get motor_pwm_protocol
motor_pwm_protocol = DSHOT600
# get motor_idle
motor_idle = 550
options: 35 is above the allowed limit, it must be ≤ 20
motor_idle 550 overrides the dynamic idle target and disables its controller
Without eRPM telemetry the dynamic idle target is zeroed at initialization
DSHOT600 is incompatible with dynamic idle, DSHOT300 is needed
questions.explain: mixerInitProfile(): dynIdleMinRps = dyn_idle_min_rpm·100/60 only if useDshotTelemetry, otherwise 0. There is no error, the feature simply does not work. The range of dyn_idle_min_rpm is 0–200, and motor_idle (before 2025.12 — dshot_idle_value) does not serve as a floor when dynamic idle is working.

questions.q: Betaflight 2025.12, default rates (Actual, roll_rc_rate 7, roll_srate 67, expo 0), angle_limit 60. What is the roll target angle in Angle with the stick at 50 % of travel?
questions.explain: pidLevel(): target = angle_limit · setpoint / max_rate. The setpoint at half stick = 0.5·70 + 600·0.5·0.5 = 185 °/s, the maximum is 670 °/s, 60·185/670 = 16.6°. 30° would be with linear rates, 27.5° — by the old 4.4 formula with level_limit 55.

questions.q: Horizon in 2025.12 with the defaults (horizon_level_strength 75, horizon_limit_sticks 75, horizon_limit_degrees 135). The aircraft is level, the roll stick is at 50 %. What is the leveling strength?
questions.explain: calcHorizonLevelStrength(): 0.75 · (1 − 0/135) · (1 − 0.5/0.75) = 0.75 · 1/3 = 0.25. With the stick at 75 % the strength is already 0 — pure ACRO.

questions.q: A quad in 3D with DShot. The pilot changes 3d_deadband_low from 1406 to 1450. What will change?
options: Nothing: these boundaries are used only for PWM/OneShot
Reverse will start at a throttle of 1450 µs instead of 1406, the deadband will narrow
The idle in the reverse direction will become higher
Arming will be possible only above 1450 µs
questions.explain: 3d_deadband_low/high, 3d_neutral and 3d_limit_* are read only by analogInitEndpoints() (drivers/motor.c). With DShot the split is fixed in dshot.c: 48–1047 — reverse, 1048–2047 — forward. Arming depends on 3d_deadband_throttle around mid_rc.

questions.q: The LAUNCH CONTROL switch is on, but after arming the OSD does not show LAUNCH. Which of these causes really blocks launch control in 2025.12?
options: Airmode is enabled
launch_angle_limit is not set, so the mode has nothing to rely on
Arming was done with the sticks, not with a switch
launch_control_gain is less than 50
questions.explain: canUseLaunchControl() requires switch arming, ACRO mode, no feature 3D, and with MOTOR_STOP — airmode as well. launch_angle_limit = 0 simply removes the angle limit, and the gain affects only the hold.

questions.q: Which CLI line do you enter so that FLIP OVER AFTER CRASH is enabled on AUX3 in the upper position (slot 3)?
questions.explain: The format: slot, permanentId (FLIP OVER AFTER CRASH = 35 in msp_box.c), channel from zero (AUX3 = 2), range, logic, linked mode. 47 is ACRO TRAINER, 13 is BEEPER, channel 3 is AUX4.

questions.q: Dynamic idle: dyn_idle_min_rpm 30, dyn_idle_p_gain 50, airmode latched. The slowest motor is spinning at 2000 RPM. What increase to the lower motor limit does the P term alone give?
questions.explain: The error is (3000 − 2000)/60 = 16.67 rev/s, P = 50·0.00015 = 0.0075 per 1 rev/s, giving 0.125 = 12.5 %. That is less than the dyn_idle_max_increase limit (15 %). Until the throttle is first raised above the airmode threshold a smaller limit applies: in 2025.12 it is motor_idle (5.5 %), in 4.5 — dyn_idle_start_increase (5 %).
